requirements.quote:
The simplest
   model presents the stream as "open" when either sending or receiving
   parts are in a non-terminal state
requirements.condition: When an implementation uses the simplest composite-state model and either the sending part or receiving part is in a non-terminal state
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation's sending and receiving part states can be compared with its reported composite stream state.

requirements.quote:
The simplest
   model presents the stream as "open" when either sending or receiving
   parts are in a non-terminal state and "closed" when both sending and
   receiving streams are in terminal states.
requirements.condition: When an implementation uses the simplest composite-state model and both the sending and receiving parts are in terminal states
requirements.why_checkable: A test can place both stream parts into terminal states and inspect the resulting composite state.

requirements.quote:
this mapping
   requires that data be acknowledged before the transition to a
   "closed" or "half-closed" state.
requirements.condition: When an implementation uses the Table 2 composite-state mapping and is transitioning based on sent data
requirements.required_behavior: Wait until the data is acknowledged before transitioning to a "closed" or "half-closed" composite state.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Transition to a "closed" or "half-closed" composite state before the data is acknowledged.
requirements.why_checkable: Acknowledgment status and the timing of composite-state transitions are observable state-machine properties.

requirements.quote: | No Stream / Ready | No Stream / Recv (*1) | idle            |
requirements.condition: When using the Table 2 mapping and the sending part is "No Stream" or "Ready" while the receiving part is "No Stream" or qualifying "Recv"
requirements.required_behavior: Map the bidirectional stream to the "idle" composite state.
requirements.why_checkable: The component-state combination and mapped composite state can be compared directly.

requirements.quote:
| Ready / Send /    | Recv / Size Known     | open            |
      | Data Sent         |                       |                 |
requirements.condition: When using the Table 2 mapping, the sending part is "Ready", "Send", or "Data Sent", and the receiving part is "Recv" or "Size Known"
requirements.required_behavior: Map the bidirectional stream to the "open" composite state.
requirements.why_checkable: Each listed Cartesian combination of sending and receiving states has a fixed composite-state mapping.

requirements.why_checkable: Each listed component-state combination has an explicit composite-state result.

requirements.quote:
A stream is considered "idle" if it has not yet been
      |  created or if the receiving part of the stream is in the "Recv"
      |  state without yet having received any frames.
requirements.condition: When determining whether a stream is "idle" under the Table 2 mapping
requirements.required_behavior: Consider the stream "idle" if it has not yet been created, or if its receiving part is in "Recv" and has not yet received any frames.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Treat a stream whose receiving part is in "Recv" but has already received a frame as satisfying this stated idle condition.
requirements.why_checkable: Stream creation, receiving-part state, and whether any frame has been received are observable implementation state.
